# What is your TRIR actually going to say on that prequalification form?

> Free OSHA TRIR and DART rate calculator: turn your OSHA 300 log's recordable case count and total hours worked into the two rates GC prequalification forms and insurance renewals ask for, and see how many injury-free hours it takes to hit a target rate. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
